title: Do biogeochemical anomalies have the same scales as physical ones
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity and sea surface height and CMEMS biogeochemical reanalysis monthly chlorophyll, nitrate and oxygen for 2011-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), estimate the horizontal length scales and the persistence in time of the anomalies of each variable, determine whether the biogeochemical fields vary on shorter or longer scales than the physical ones, where and at which depths, and explain the differences. The two products have different grids and come from different model systems; show how much of the difference this alone produces.
